strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Tango 2 has landed on Deck 3.@The PTX Team has returned to the ship.
Executive Officer. The Commander has ordered@Lieutenant Irmgard to report immediately.@Have her sent to Deck 3.
Understood.@Relaying the Commander's order to report@to Lieutenant Irmgard.
Sergeant Major Azuki, any new information on@the unknowns that appeared on the moon?
Captain, we may come into contact with the unknowns.@Shouldn't we suspend the shakedown cruise@for the new formation?
That decision isn't mine to make. I'll confirm@as soon as Lieutenant Irmgard finishes her report.
Then at least cancel training preparations@and order Level 2 battle stations...
I don't mind you giving me your opinion.@You were this ship's previous captain, after all.
No... Accident or not, the ship under my command@took the life of the former President.@I consider my punishment more than fair.
That was thanks to your record so far.@And to keep the powerful <Steel Dragons>@under tighter control...
Commander Miles was dispatched from the Joint@Chiefs of Staff. Don't forget that.
Ooh, the red Exbein's not half bad either.
The Type L has a different antenna shape.
Actually, they're dummies. If delivery hadn't been moved@up, we'd have installed a high-performance comm@module and a prototype air data sensor.
Lieutenant Irm's test results were good.
Yeah, even without telekinesis,@I can use the telekinetic weapons@that work with that system.
Of course, it's no match for the real@<T-LINK System> or a <Telekinetic>.
No, if that thing just casually outperformed@the R Series, where would that@leave us...
Well, there are plenty of walls to get over.@Not just performance, but cost too.
Still, thanks to the APT-LINK System, we've got@a lot more options for switching machines.
Yeah. We readjusted the Exexbein's T-LINK System@too, so people other than Ing can use it.
By the way, the new PTX Team is all blue machines:@the Grungust Kai, the Exbein Type R,@and the Exexbein...
Only Rio's Type L is red, huh?
The one rose among the thorns, right?
Ha, good one.@So that machine over there is@<Ashurey Kreuzer>'s...
Its legs are way too thin... I mean,@the shins are basically just plates.@No way it can fight on the ground like that.
So what? It's built for aerial combat.@Everything below the knees is basically landing gear.
She's the Bellzelute's pilot.@Well then, White Lynx.@We're reporting to the unit commander.
Meeting the top brass right away?@What an unexpected welcome.
No kidding. Just don't expect dinner.
I'll take you to the mess hall.@You might not have an appetite,@but you should eat something.
Oh, she was aboard the Bellzelute too.
What, seriously? She's just a kid.
So what? That one there is about@the same age as me, isn't she?
Don't treat me like a kid.@Besides, it's not like I want to be here...
Anyway, let's head to the mess hall.@I'm hungry too.
Lieutenant Irmgard Kazahara reporting,@together with former Lieutenant@Calvina Coulange.
Lieutenant Irmgard...@why did you bring her here?
Huh? You ordered me to report, sir...
I mean from the start.@You should never have brought former Lieutenant@Calvina Coulange aboard this ship.
But we can't overlook illegal combat.@She needs to be questioned, or face an inquiry.
Exactly.@But where did that battle take place?@That's a matter for Lunar District HQ to decide.
It's no concern of a unit that happened to come up@to space on a shakedown cruise. You should have handed@former Lieutenant Calvina over to the Lunar District.
No, you should have asked for my judgment before@rushing to the scene in the first place. Yet you acted@on your own and failed to report to me.
(If I say it was a judgment call in an emergency,@this'll just drag on...)
However, since former Lieutenant Calvina Coulange@is now aboard this ship, it can't be helped. I've@reported it to the Lunar District and Joint Chiefs.
Until an official decision comes down,@the former Lieutenant may move freely@only within the residential block.
I can't enter the combat areas?@You've got to be kidding. If those guys show up,@I'm going out in the Bellzelute.
Kidding? I could say the same. I cannot authorize@illegal combat by a civilian in a humanoid@mobile weapon.
The last battle may be deemed self-defense,@but I can't overlook it from here on.
Until the inquiry that will eventually be held,@the Bellzelute and the civilian girl with you will be@under our jurisdiction. Understand that.
You can't just decide that for your own convenience...!
You should consider yourself lucky not to be@treated as a criminal and placed in custody.
Now, Lieutenant Irmgard.@Escort former Lieutenant Calvina Coulange@to the residential block.
...I thought the famous Steel Dragons@would have a more casual atmosphere.
Well, it was like that until recently.@Anyway, here's the mess hall. Pretty well stocked@for a warship, I'd say.
I'm not that interested.@As long as I get the calories I need, that's fine.
Hey, so here you are... Wait, what's this?@All these plates... You guys ate all that?
Seriously?@Even a grown man couldn't eat that much alone.
Actually, um... I was really, really hungry...
Don't worry about it. Right, Ryoto?
(I wonder if she eats this much every time...?)
So, Lieutenant Irm. How'd it go?
You think I got called into the Commander's office@to be praised? He lectured me about how@I shouldn't have done any of it to begin with.
Aah, figures.@I got preached at for a good hour the other day too.@Over wrecking too many target drones.
I'd love to see him go at it for real with Rai.@That guy's got a sharp tongue too.
Raidiese wouldn't do anything that'd get him@scolded by the Commander in the first place...
Doesn't do much for my standing as leader, huh?
...Hey, what's going to happen to me now?
We're waiting on the bigwigs' decision.
Festenia, get some rest while you're on this ship.
Thanks. And you can call me Tenia.@That's what Mom and Dad called me.
Then what about Calvina?@Should we call you Karin?
XO to all hands.@A group of unidentified units has been sighted ahead@of the ship. Halt training prep. Level 1 battle stations.
Calm down. We're sortieing, but you stay put.
But if it's them, you can't stop me.@I'm taking the Bellzelute.
I can't say I don't get how you feel,@but don't do anything rash.@Getting thrown in a cell will only set you back.
(Ally said something like that to me once...)
...XO, didn't Zovorg decide not to interfere@with Earth's sphere after <The Sealing War>?
Yes, sir. Unofficially, we heard so directly from@Mekibos Borquede, envoy of the Zovorg@<Privy Council>.
They deceived us.@This is what comes of trusting aliens.
(Even in this situation, the Captain has to check@with the Commander on every little thing?)
We can't carelessly open hostilities ourselves.@We'll withdraw for now and seek instructions@from the Joint Chiefs of Staff...
(If he doesn't give the order to intercept soon,@we're in trouble!)
Captain, withdraw from the combat zone at once.@However, engaging the target group is forbidden.
I'll do my best, but the ship will very likely be@damaged. That could hinder our future operations.@Is that acceptable?
Hm...@Then it can't be helped. Interception is authorized.
Understood.@Maintain course, both engines ahead, battle speed one.@Fire short-range SAMs, then launch all units. Intercept!
(...So the Captain isn't just swallowing@the Commander's orders whole.)
...It took a weirdly long time@for the launch order.
Yeah. It was never like this before.
Blame the delicate relationship between those three.
Is it okay for you to say that?
Still, to think Zovorg would attack us again...@Was what Mekibos told us a lie?
There must be some who act regardless of the@Privy Council's wishes. Like <Golaikunru>, the war@merchants who backed <Zezenan>, for instance.
You mean they're starting a war of invasion now?
No, it's not necessarily an invasion. In the last war,@some of them tried to get their hands@on the <Cross Gate>.
That's enough chatter.@Spread out and intercept the enemy.
All enemy signals in the combat area are gone!
Maintain full-perimeter alert.@Have all mobile units return to the ship.
Sergeant Major Azuki, open a line@to the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
(If we're their target, it wouldn't be odd for them@to use warp tactics on us...)
Damn Zovorg, when are they gonna@pull out of Earth for good?!
(Zovorg shouldn't be able to carelessly start a war@this time either... Is it Golaikunru,@like Lieutenant Irm said?)
And it hasn't been that long@since the Sealing War ended...
...That is an overview of the battle.
I understand the situation.@I have no intention of holding you responsible@for opening hostilities on your own judgment.
From a preliminary examination of the recovered@wreckage, they closely resemble their mobile weapons@seen in <The Sealing War>.
However, we can't rule out a deception by another@faction that obtained those weapons.
Understood.@Any inquiry or protest to Zovorg@will come from the Federation Government.
Then we'll continue our shakedown cruise.
No, have the Steel Dragons head for the <Cross Gate>@and join up with the surveillance fleet. It's a precaution@against hostiles apparently connected to Zovorg.
Understood.@If we come into contact with Zovorg forces again,@how should we proceed?
Handle it as the situation demands.@Any other questions?
...Captain, you heard him.@This ship will now head for Cross Gate Space.
Come to think of it, you're a lucky man.
You lost your ship in the last war, and right@in front of you was a large battle carrier whose@captain had been demoted over a scandal...
Without a miracle like that, you'd never have been@given another ship. You might have been posted@to some small frontier base.
Good. That's how it should be.
(...Being in charge of the Steel Dragons, I suppose@handling emergencies on the spot is inevitable.)
(Then I'll show I can handle them. That's how I can@prove my ability to the mainstream faction@of the Joint Chiefs of Staff...)
Huh, we're going to the Cross Gate now?
Yeah, though they didn't tell us why.
Near the end of <The Sealing War>, <Golaikunru>@acted on its own to seize the Cross Gate. Maybe@they're expecting something similar to happen?
Those guys can use space warp tactics, y'know.@If they wanted to, couldn't they just hit@the Cross Gate directly?
Either it's impossible for some reason,@or they're choosing not to use that tactic...
Hmm, something doesn't add up.@Maybe it's some other enemy pretending to be Zovorg.
Either way, getting tossed into danger zones is@the Steel Dragons' fate. Even more so now that@we report directly to the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
So Commander Miles can score some points?
Ryu, you shouldn't say things like that.
Then, Lieutenant Irm. I have a favor to ask.
I never turn down a date, you know?
I want to start up the Bellzelute.@Of course, I have no intention of going outside.@You can keep me under watch.
Totally ignored, huh? Well, setting that aside.@Tell me why.
I want to see whether I can start it up.
Huh?@Then how did you get it moving before@you ran into the PTX Team on the moon?
Back then, I was inside Ashurey Kreuzer,@and there was an external starter.
You've never started it up by yourself@anywhere else?
That's right. That's why I want to try.
